datasets.name: popquorn_offensiveness
datasets.selection: lam chosen per cell on validation normalized RPS (mean over subsample seeds)
datasets.learning_curve_interval_definition: 95% percentile interval from 1000 resamples of the TEST PROMPTS (item-clustered; one vector per prompt, averaged over the subsample seeds). It reflects test-prompt sampling only; the spread over training-subsample seeds is in learning_curve_k1_seed_means. gain_over_constant_paired = test normalized RPS of the constant forecast minus that of the CE-trained head at its validation-chosen penalty; positive means the head is better.

128.difference_definition: test normalized RPS of the k-ratings-per-item head minus test normalized RPS of the one-rating-per-item head, same total budget B, each head at its validation-chosen penalty; positive means the one-rating-per-item head is better

256.difference_definition: test normalized RPS of the k-ratings-per-item head minus test normalized RPS of the one-rating-per-item head, same total budget B, each head at its validation-chosen penalty; positive means the one-rating-per-item head is better

512.difference_definition: test normalized RPS of the k-ratings-per-item head minus test normalized RPS of the one-rating-per-item head, same total budget B, each head at its validation-chosen penalty; positive means the one-rating-per-item head is better

paired_vs_constant.definition: test normalized RPS of the constant forecast minus test normalized RPS of the CE-trained head at its validation-chosen penalty (full training set, split seed 0); positive means the CE-trained head is better
